import "math"

// =================== Parameter ===================
scan_curr_days       = 45d
scan_tstart_days     = 90d
target_distance_km   = 600.0
win                  = 5m
odo_standstill_km    = 0.01
battery_capacity_kWh = 72.6   // Brutto

// =================== Feldnamen ===================
soc_field     = "[BMS] State of Charge Display (%)"
soh_field     = "[BMS] State of Health (%)"
rem_bms_field = "[BMS] Remaining energy (Wh)"   // in kWh umrechnen
carFilter = "${car}"
ownershipFilter = "${ownership}"


// =================== STEP1 — letzte SoC / SoH / BMS-Remaining ===================
soc_last =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start:-scan_curr_days)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field==soc_field)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn:last, createEmpty:false)
    |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc:true)
    |> limit(n:1)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: now(), k:"1", metric:"soc_pct", value: float(v:r._value) }))

soh_last =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start:-scan_curr_days)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field==soh_field)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn:last, createEmpty:false)
    |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc:true)
    |> limit(n:1)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: now(), k:"1", metric:"soh_pct", value: float(v:r._value) }))

rem_bms_last =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start:-scan_curr_days)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field==rem_bms_field)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn:last, createEmpty:false)
    |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc:true)
    |> limit(n:1)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: now(), k:"1", metric:"remaining_kWh_bms", value: float(v:r._value) / 1000.0 }))

step1 = union(tables:[soc_last, soh_last, rem_bms_last])

// =================== STEP2 — Verbrauch aus 600-km-Block ===================
curr =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start:-scan_curr_days)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field=="[DASH] Odometer (km)")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty:false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> tail(n:1)

curr_rec   = curr |> findRecord(fn:(key)=> true, idx:0)
curr_odo   = float(v: curr_rec._value)
target_odo = curr_odo - target_distance_km

trow =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start:-scan_tstart_days)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field=="[DASH] Odometer (km)")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty:false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> float(v:r._value) >= target_odo)
    |> limit(n:1)
    |> findRecord(fn:(key)=> true, idx:0)

t_start = trow._time

odo_delta =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start: t_start)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field=="[DASH] Odometer (km)")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: win, fn: last, createEmpty:false)
    |> difference(nonNegative: false)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: r._time, delta_odo_km: if exists r._value and r._value > 0.0 then float(v:r._value) else 0.0 }))

dis_delta =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start: t_start)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field=="[BMS] Cumulative Energy Discharged (kWh)")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: win, fn: last, createEmpty:false)
    |> difference(nonNegative: false)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: r._time, delta_dis_kWh: if exists r._value then float(v:r._value) else 0.0 }))

chg_delta =
  from(bucket:"carscanner_tagged")
    |> range(start: t_start)
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="carscanner" and r._field=="[BMS] Cumulative Energy Charged (kWh)")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: win, fn: last, createEmpty:false)
    |> difference(nonNegative: false)
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({ _time: r._time, delta_chg_kWh: if exists r._value then float(v:r._value) else 0.0 }))

j1 = join(tables:{a: odo_delta, b: dis_delta}, on: ["_time"], method: "inner")
j2 = join(tables:{a: j1,       b: chg_delta}, on: ["_time"], method: "inner")

d =
  j2
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({
      _time: r._time,
      delta_odo_km:  r.delta_odo_km,
      delta_net_kWh: r.delta_dis_kWh - r.delta_chg_kWh
    }))
    |> filter(fn:(r)=> not( (r.delta_net_kWh < 0.0) and (r.delta_odo_km <= odo_standstill_km) ))

cons_only =
  d
    |> reduce(
        identity:{dist:0.0, energy:0.0},
        fn:(r,accumulator)=>({
          dist:   accumulator.dist   + r.delta_odo_km,
          energy: accumulator.energy + r.delta_net_kWh
        })
      )
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({
      _time: now(),
      k: "1",
      metric: "consumption_kWh_100km",
      value: if r.dist <= 0.0 then 0.0 else math.round(x: (r.energy / r.dist) * 100.0 * 100.0)/100.0
    }))

// =================== STEP3 — Pivot, Remaining(calc) & Reichweiten ===================
safe =
  union(tables:[step1, cons_only])
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> pivot(rowKey:["k"], columnKey:["metric"], valueColumn:"value")
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({
      _time: now(),
      soc_pct:               if exists r.soc_pct               then float(v:r.soc_pct)               else 0.0,
      soh_pct:               if exists r.soh_pct               then float(v:r.soh_pct)               else 0.0,
      remaining_kWh_bms:     if exists r.remaining_kWh_bms     then float(v:r.remaining_kWh_bms)     else 0.0,
      consumption_kWh_100km: if exists r.consumption_kWh_100km then float(v:r.consumption_kWh_100km) else 0.0
    }))

final_row =
  safe
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({
      _time: r._time,
      // Calculated Remaining = Kapazität * SoH * SoC
      remaining_kWh_calc: (battery_capacity_kWh * (r.soh_pct/100.0)) * (r.soc_pct/100.0),
      remaining_kWh_bms:  r.remaining_kWh_bms,
      soc_pct:            r.soc_pct,
      soh_pct:            r.soh_pct,
      consumption_kWh_100km: r.consumption_kWh_100km
    }))
    |> map(fn:(r)=>({
      _time: r._time,
      consumption_kWh_100km: r.consumption_kWh_100km,
      // Reichweite (calc) = Remaining(calc) / (Verbrauch/100)
      range_km_est:
        if r.consumption_kWh_100km <= 0.0 then 0.0
        else math.round(x: (r.remaining_kWh_calc / (r.consumption_kWh_100km / 100.0)) * 10.0) / 10.0,
      // Reichweite (BMS) = Remaining(BMS) / (Verbrauch/100)
      range_km_est_bms:
        if r.consumption_kWh_100km <= 0.0 then 0.0
        else math.round(x: (r.remaining_kWh_bms  / (r.consumption_kWh_100km / 100.0)) * 10.0) / 10.0,
      // Abweichung Remaining (kWh & %)
      remaining_delta_kWh: r.remaining_kWh_calc - r.remaining_kWh_bms,
      remaining_delta_pct: if r.remaining_kWh_calc > 0.0
                           then ((r.remaining_kWh_bms / r.remaining_kWh_calc) - 1.0) * 100.0
                           else 0.0,
      remaining_kWh_calc: r.remaining_kWh_calc,
      remaining_kWh_bms:  r.remaining_kWh_bms,
      soc_pct:            r.soc_pct,
      soh_pct:            r.soh_pct
    }))
    |> keep(columns:[
      "consumption_kWh_100km",
      "range_km_est",
      "range_km_est_bms",
      "remaining_kWh_calc",
      "remaining_kWh_bms",
      "remaining_delta_kWh",
      "remaining_delta_pct",
      "soc_pct",
      "soh_pct",
      "_time"
    ])

final_row 
  |> drop(columns: ["range_km_est_bms","remaining_delta_kWh","remaining_delta_pct","remaining_kWh_calc"])
  |> yield(name:"LEAN_600km_dashboard")

carFilter = "${car}"
ownershipFilter = "${ownership}"

from(bucket: "carscanner_tagged")

import "strings"
import "regexp"

bucketName = "carscanner_tagged"
measurementName = "carscanner"
carFilter = "${car}"
ownershipFilter = "${ownership}"

odometerField = "[DASH] Odometer (km)"
dischargedField = "[BMS] Cumulative Energy Discharged (kWh)"
chargedField = "[BMS] Cumulative Energy Charged (kWh)"

odometer = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == odometerField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      odo_first: 0.0,
      odo_last: 0.0,
      trip_end_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      odo_first: if accumulator.odo_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.odo_first,
      odo_last: r._value,
      trip_end_time: r._time
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    odo_first: r.odo_first,
    odo_last: r.odo_last,
    distance_km: r.odo_last - r.odo_first,
    trip_end_time: r.trip_end_time
  }))

discharged = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == dischargedField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      discharged_first: 0.0,
      discharged_last: 0.0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      discharged_first: if accumulator.discharged_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.discharged_first,
      discharged_last: r._value
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    discharged_delta_kWh: r.discharged_last - r.discharged_first
  }))

charged = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == chargedField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      charged_first: 0.0,
      charged_last: 0.0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      charged_first: if accumulator.charged_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.charged_first,
      charged_last: r._value
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    charged_delta_kWh: r.charged_last - r.charged_first
  }))

joinStep1 = join(
  tables: {odo: odometer, dis: discharged},
  on: ["trip"]
)

joinStep2 = join(
  tables: {step1: joinStep1, chg: charged},
  on: ["trip"]
)

joinStep2
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    netKwh = r.discharged_delta_kWh - r.charged_delta_kWh
    consumption = if r.distance_km > 0.0 then (netKwh / r.distance_km) * 100.0 else 0.0
    
    tripShort = strings.substring(v: r.trip, start: 5, end: 16)

      _value: consumption,
      trip: tripShort
    }
  })
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)

import "strings"
import "regexp"
import "date"

bucketName = "carscanner_tagged"
measurementName = "carscanner"
carFilter = "Ioniq5_MY22"
ownershipFilter = "dienstwagen"

odometerField = "[DASH] Odometer (km)"
dischargedField = "[BMS] Cumulative Energy Discharged (kWh)"
chargedField = "[BMS] Cumulative Energy Charged (kWh)"

odometer = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == odometerField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      odo_first: 0.0,
      odo_last: 0.0,
      trip_end_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      odo_first: if accumulator.odo_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.odo_first,
      odo_last: r._value,
      trip_end_time: r._time
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    odo_first: r.odo_first,
    odo_last: r.odo_last,
    distance_km: r.odo_last - r.odo_first,
    trip_end_time: r.trip_end_time
  }))

discharged = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == dischargedField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      discharged_first: 0.0,
      discharged_last: 0.0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      discharged_first: if accumulator.discharged_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.discharged_first,
      discharged_last: r._value
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    discharged_delta_kWh: r.discharged_last - r.discharged_first
  }))

charged = from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurementName)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == chargedField)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ownership == ownershipFilter)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.car == carFilter)
  |> group(columns: ["trip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      trip: "",
      charged_first: 0.0,
      charged_last: 0.0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      trip: r.trip,
      charged_first: if accumulator.charged_first == 0.0 then r._value else accumulator.charged_first,
      charged_last: r._value
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    trip: r.trip,
    charged_delta_kWh: r.charged_last - r.charged_first
  }))

joinStep1 = join(
  tables: {odo: odometer, dis: discharged},
  on: ["trip"]
)

joinStep2 = join(
  tables: {step1: joinStep1, chg: charged},
  on: ["trip"]
)

// Trip-Verbrauch berechnen und dann pro Kalendermonat mitteln
monthly = joinStep2
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    netKwh = r.discharged_delta_kWh - r.charged_delta_kWh
    consumption = if r.distance_km > 0.0 then (netKwh / r.distance_km) * 100.0 else 0.0

    tripShort = strings.substring(v: r.trip, start: 5, end: 16)

    return {
      _time: r.trip_end_time,
      _value: consumption,
      trip: tripShort
    }
  })
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  // Jahr und Monat aus _time ziehen
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    year:  date.year(t: r._time),
    month: date.month(t: r._time)
  }))
  // pro Jahr+Monat zusammenfassen
  |> group(columns: ["year", "month"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      year: 0,
      month: 0,
      sum: 0.0,
      count: 0.0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      year:  r.year,
      month: r.month,
      sum:   accumulator.sum + r._value,
      count: accumulator.count + 1.0
    })
  )
  // Durchschnitt berechnen und _time auf den 1. des Monats setzen
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: time(
      v: string(v: r.year) +
        "-" +
        (if r.month < 10 then "0" + string(v: r.month) else string(v: r.month)) +
        "-01T00:00:00Z"
    ),
    _value: r.sum / r.count
  }))
  // nur Zeit + Wert zurückgeben, keine Labels mehr
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  // alles wieder zu **einer** Serie zusammenfassen
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)
